$comment: Recipes for the two synthetic disclosure studies. design/tools/build-exports.mjs writes them to design/studies/ with a manifest of their own. They are not assets and are in no bundle: no approved fact exists for what they draw (RULE-003 / D09). A recipe here may read only from source/studies/.
